slice: Diagnosis of the refused 125 % identity-bound capture path
scope_note: Diagnosis only. No product, token, probe, harness, dependency or contract change; the stop conditions were reached before any code edit.

existing_api_inventory.capture_method: bitmap sized from GetWindowRect, PrintWindow(PW_RENDERFULLCONTENT) into that DC, then a 7x7 comparison against CopyFromScreen over the same rectangle intersected with the virtual screen (GetSystemMetrics 76-79)
existing_api_inventory.consequence: the captured bitmap is forced to the GetWindowRect size, so an image/rect size check can pass while the underlying coordinate space still differs from the display

same_host_dpi_marker.meaning: the probe-host process reports a 96 DPI desktop while the target window's own GetDpiForWindow is 120, i.e. the host does not follow the 125 % scale for this query
same_host_dpi_marker.method_is_existing: System.Drawing/.NET only; no new Win32 declaration

host_screen_views.note: a second display is present above/right of the primary; Screen.Bounds still reports physical size for this host, so it is not by itself an awareness proof and is recorded only as environment

probe_geometry_by_scale.delta: width -2, height -1: the probe-reported window did not grow with the scale

physical_window_by_scale.delta: width +320, height +207, i.e. roughly the 1.25 factor

discrepancy_magnitude.frame_accounting_at_100_percent: the two tools differ by about 14x7 pixels, which is the order of window-frame and shadow accounting
discrepancy_magnitude.conclusion: frame accounting cannot explain a 308x201 gap, so the probe geometry is in a different (DPI-scaled) space rather than merely a differently framed physical rectangle

measurements.shell_independence: the harness's documented --powershell option pointed at PowerShell 7 returned the same 1294x838 geometry and the same 43/49 refusal as Windows PowerShell, so the result is not a shell-version artefact

classification.A_dpi_coordinate_space_mismatch: SUPPORTED: the probe host reports a 96 DPI marker at 125 %, its reported window geometry does not follow the 1.25 physical growth, and the resulting gap is far beyond frame accounting. This establishes a coordinate-space divergence only.
classification.B_window_frame_accounting: EXCLUDED as the primary cause: the observed 308x201 gap is an order of magnitude beyond the ~14x7 frame difference measured at 100 %.
classification.C_sample_position_calculation: NOT ISOLATED: the 7x7 positions are computed from the same rectangle on both sides, so a space mismatch alone would explain the disagreement without a separate arithmetic fault; no independent arithmetic error was found by inspection.
classification.D_actual_occlusion: NO POSITIVE EVIDENCE, NOT EXCLUDED: the window was focused and produced an identical 43/49 three times, which argues against a transient overlay, but a static overlay or a static compositing difference on the same pixels would also repeat exactly, so repetition alone cannot exclude occlusion.
classification.E_printwindow_resampling_difference: POSSIBLE CONTRIBUTOR, NOT ISOLATED: 43 of 49 samples still agree, so most sampled content is aligned; the 6 disagreements are consistent with edge/text resampling under a scale mismatch but were not separated from a residual offset.
classification.G_insufficient_evidence: applies only to the exact mechanism: the probe record carries no compared rectangles, no per-sample deltas and no probe-side screen-metric snapshot, so the remaining 6 samples are not attributed.
classification.direct_cause_of_the_43_49_refusal: NOT_DIAGNOSED: the compared 49 sample coordinates and their RGB deltas are not recorded, so it is not established that the coordinate-space divergence produced the 43/49 result, nor that the six disagreeing samples come from that divergence rather than from resampling, an overlay, or a residual offset.

acceptance.AC01_cause_classified_with_evidence: PARTIAL: the coordinate-space divergence is SUPPORTED with evidence; its direct contribution to the 43/49 refusal and the cause of the remaining six samples are NOT_DIAGNOSED. B is excluded as the primary cause by magnitude; D has no positive evidence but is not excluded by repetition alone; C and E remain not isolated.
acceptance.AC02_coordinate_space_and_awareness_proo: PARTIAL: the host's 96 DPI marker and the geometry divergence are observed; the API-level awareness flag itself was not queried because doing so needs a new Win32 call in the probe.
acceptance.AC03_minimal_fix_when_cause_proven: NOT APPLIED: the fix needs new authority (below), so no code was edited.
acceptance.AC04_96_dpi_identity_preserved: UNCHANGED: nothing in the probe or harness was modified.
acceptance.AC05_125_rejections_preserved: UNCHANGED: thresholds, 45/49 requirement, tolerance 24, identity checks and blank/PNG refusals are untouched.
acceptance.AC06_120_dpi_image_accepted: NOT ACHIEVED: no accepted 120 DPI image exists.
acceptance.AC07_before_after_comparison: DONE for geometry: 100 % probe 1296x839 against 125 % 1294x838, and 100 % physical 1282x832 against 125 % 1602x1039.
acceptance.AC08_owned_and_shared_regressions: RECORDED: n03 observe suite 19 tests OK (1 skipped) and typography suite 71 tests OK, both unchanged this slice; the shared R0 suite keeps its known HOLD result from section 19.91 (352 cases, 1 failure, 11 errors, 12 skipped) and was not re-run or rewritten.
acceptance.AC09_gate_for_verification_code: NOT APPLICABLE: no verification code changed, so no Gate is claimed and none is transferred.
acceptance.AC10_hold_when_unresolved: MET: the fix is held; the pixel acceptance stays NOT_MEASURED.

blocking_decision.what_is_needed: The probe must operate in the same coordinate space as the display when the scale is fractional. Two minimal options were identified and neither is authorized by this slice.
blocking_decision.option_1: Make the probe host per-monitor DPI aware (an explicit awareness call or a manifest change). This adds a new Win32 declaration or an OS-facing process change, which the directive's stop conditions name explicitly.
blocking_decision.option_2: Pass the already measured scale factor from the harness into the shared R0 probe and have it compute the physical rectangle. This changes the shared R0 probe's argument contract, which is also a named stop condition, and it would need an R0A/R0B/R0C impact review.
blocking_decision.not_authorized: Lowering 45/49, replacing PrintWindow with a screen copy, weakening 96 DPI identity proof, changing Windows DPI awareness system settings, or adding dependencies.
blocking_decision.requested_judgement: Whether to authorize option 1 or option 2 (with the shared-probe impact review) as its own bounded slice, or to keep 120 DPI pixel acceptance deferred.
